newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai offshore loans slip in March.
newsitem.headline: Thai offshore loans slip in March.

text.p: The Bank of Thailand said on Thursday that total outstanding loans extended by offshore banking units declined to 1.24 trillion baht ($49.6 billion) at the end of March from 1.28 trillion at the end of February.
The loans were granted through the Bangkok International Banking Facility (BIBF).

The central bank said the loans brought in by commercial banks for relending to domestic borrowers rose 0.7 percent to 838.1 billion baht at the end of March from 832.3 billion at the end of previous month.
Cumulative foreign loans of offshore banking units for relending to third country borrowers dropped to 397 billion baht at the end of March from 450.1 billion at the end of February, it said.
